# Europa Regina

> > Europa Regina explores creative industries and regional integration frameworks across South America, focusing on UNASUR, Mercosur, and Andean Community development.

This site examines the intersection of creative economy development and regional cooperation in South America, analyzing how intergovernmental unions like UNASUR, Mercosur, and the Andean Community shape cultural and creative sector growth. The platform provides insights into South American regional integration models and their relationship with global frameworks including the European Union.

## Key Topics

- South America
- UNASUR (Union of South American Nations)
- Mercosur
- Andean Community of Nations
- Creative Industries
- Regional Integration
- Intergovernmental Union
- Brazil
- Andes Region
- European Union
- Cultural Economy
- South American Cooperation

## Creative Industries & Regional Development

- [South America Creative Industries](https://europaregina.eu/creative-industries/south-america): Creative industry development in South America via UNASUR, Mercosur, Andean Community frameworks and regional integration strategies
